PROGRAM Main
  VAR
    Start : BOOL;
  END_VAR
  ...
END_PROGRAM

calc.title: Calculations

vfd.intro: Pick a drive for a motor from a manufacturer's range: ABB ACS880-01 by default, or any series listed. The motor current is worked out from its rating, and the smallest drive whose rating for the duty, derated for temperature and altitude by its own manual, carries it is chosen.

bom.intro: List the panel's loads and describe the enclosure. The BOM holds what a sourced table can size: a drive for each variable-speed load from the series chosen (ABB ACS880-01, with its input fuses, by default), a Type 2 coordinated starter for each motor started across the line (400, 440, 500 or 690 V), a curve C breaker for each other load, an outgoing cable and its terminals for each load, the enclosure, and the cooling it needs by IEC 60890.

placement.suite_end_wall: End of a suite, against a wall
placement.suite_middle_wall: Middle of a suite, against a wall
placement.suite_middle_wall_covered_roof: Middle of a suite, against a wall, roof covered

line.cable: {tag}: outgoing cable for {load}, method {method}, circuits grouped: {grouped}
line.cooling: Active cooling: {cooling} W beyond what the surface sheds at a {rise} K rise; an air/air heat exchanger needs {qw} W/K
line.fuse: {tag}: drive input fuses, aR {amps} A, one per phase (needs at least {minSc} A prospective short-circuit current)
line.terminal: {tag}: through-type terminal {size} mm², up to {max} A
line.feeder: {tag}: miniature circuit-breaker for {load}, curve {curve}, In {rated} A
line.overloadCt: {tag}: overload relay, set within {min}-{max} A, fed through current transformer {ct}

note.incomplete_dissipation: Loads without a heat figure add no heat, so the cooling figure is only as complete as the schedule.
note.not_included: Protection is not included for a load with neither a drive nor a starter whose current no curve C rating fits between the load and its cable.
note.fault_level_assumed: Starters are Type 2 coordinated up to 50 kA; confirm the panel's prospective short-circuit current does not exceed it.
note.fuse_min_short_circuit: Drive input fuses operate fast enough only when the installation's prospective short-circuit current is at least the minimum on each line.
note.terminals_copper_only: Terminals are selected from a copper terminal table; aluminium cables need terminals rated for aluminium, which are not listed.
note.drive_fuses_not_listed: Drive input fuses are listed only for the ABB ACS880-01; for the drives chosen here, take the fuses from the drive manual cited on each drive line.
note.feeder_breaking_capacity: Feeder breakers are chosen for overload (Ib ≤ In ≤ Iz); confirm their breaking capacity reaches the panel's prospective short-circuit current.

design.title: Board design
design.intro: Enter a distribution board's load schedule. Each circuit gets its breaker and cable, loads are grouped under residual current devices and spread across the phases, and the whole drawing set is generated from the result. Every figure names its source; what the design assumed is listed under the result.

suggest.help: The points are read from your description and split into circuits by your company's rules. Typical powers are used where you give none; every assumption is listed. Check each row before designing.

quote.title: Quotation
quote.intro: Upload your price list and enter your rates. Each device is matched by its order number, or by its rating key (circuit_breaker:1P:C16) until a catalogue is chosen; a line with no price is never guessed.
quote.priceListHelp: Excel or CSV with a key (or order number) column and a price column.

quote.error: The quotation could not be completed. Try again.
quote.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# line is not priced} other {# lines are not priced}} and left out of the total.

plc.title: Control program
plc.intro: The PLC program for the circuits marked PLC switched: one contactor coil per circuit, a manual-on input for each, and shared emergency-stop, hand/auto and time-clock inputs. Every coil drops when the emergency stop opens. Check it and fill in the addresses before loading it.
plc.error: The program could not be written. Try again.

status.invalid: The checker found errors in the program.

note.mccb_needed: {load}: Ib {current} A is above the largest miniature breaker held (125 A); a moulded-case breaker is needed and none is selected here. The cable is sized for Ib; check it against the breaker’s In.
note.above_company_rating: {load}: Ib {current} A exceeds the company’s {fixed} A for {kind}; rated {rated} A instead.
note.contactor_unselected: {load}: no modular contactor rating carries {current} A; the contactor is left unselected.
note.phase_imbalance: Phase imbalance {imbalance} % exceeds the company’s {limit} %: the loads cannot be spread more evenly as given.
note.incomer_mccb: Incomer: {current} A on the most loaded conductor exceeds 125 A; a moulded-case breaker is needed and none is selected here.
note.spare_ways: {count, plural, one {Leave # spare outgoing way} other {Leave # spare outgoing ways}} ({percent} %).
note.default_power_factor: Loads without a power factor were taken at cos φ 0.9.
note.contactor_ac1: Contactors are rated at least their breaker’s current (AC-1); confirm the utilisation category against the catalogue for motor or lamp loads.
note.no_fault_level: No fault level given: every breaker’s breaking capacity is left to be confirmed.
note.cable_conditions: Cables sized for method {method}, {ambient} °C, {grouped} grouped circuit(s), {insulation} °C insulation.
note.rules_unconfirmed: Circuit rules are this software’s defaults, not confirmed by the company’s engineers.
note.motor_current_table: {load}: Ir {current} A, the typical Ir of a {power} kW motor in {source}; check it against the nameplate.
note.motor_current_formula: {load}: Ir {current} A from {power} kW shaft power at cos φ {power_factor}, efficiency {efficiency}; check it against the nameplate.
note.no_overload_row: {load}: the table gives no overload relay for this row.
note.star_delta_interlock: {load}: star and delta contactors need a mechanical interlock; the motor is fed by six conductors (U1 V1 W1, U2 V2 W2).
note.drive_selected: {load}: {drive} for normal duty at {ambient} °C, behind {fuse} A aR fuses ({source}). Use a screened, symmetrical motor cable, earthed 360° at both ends.
note.drive_fuse_fault_level: {load}: the fuses need at least {current} A prospective short-circuit current at the board to operate fast enough.
note.import_spare: Row {row} ({load}): a spare way; left for the spare count.
note.import_kind_unknown: Row {row} ({load}): load type not recognised; taken as other.
note.import_kind_inferred: Row {row} ({load}): taken as {kind} from its description.
note.import_phases_unread: Row {row} ({load}): phases “{value}” not read; taken as 1.
note.import_pf_out_of_range: Row {row} ({load}): power factor {value} is out of range; ignored.
note.import_kva_only: Row {row} ({load}): only kVA given; taken as kW, which assumes cos φ 1.
note.split_points: {load}: {points} × {watts} W = {power} kW. {source, select, given {as described} other {typical value}}
note.voltage_drop_upsized: {load}: cable enlarged from {sized} to {section} mm² for voltage drop over {length} m: {total} % from the origin, within the {limit} % limit.
note.voltage_drop_exceeded: {load}: voltage drop {total} % from the origin ({own} % on its own cable, {upstream} % before the board) exceeds the {limit} % limit, and no tabulated section brings it within; kept at {section} mm². Shorten the run, run cables in parallel or enlarge the feeders.
note.voltage_drop_untabulated: {load}: {section} mm² is beyond the voltage-drop tables (up to 300 mm²); its drop is not checked.
note.voltage_drop_unchecked: {count, plural, one {# circuit has no cable length given; its voltage drop is not checked.} other {# circuits have no cable length given; their voltage drop is not checked.}}
note.voltage_drop_upstream: {percent} % is dropped on the feeders before this board, and taken from every circuit’s limit.
note.breaking_capacity: Breakers are rated for at least {rating} kA breaking capacity against {fault} kA prospective at the board; each RCCB’s conditional short-circuit current with the breaker ahead of it must reach it too.
note.breaking_capacity_beyond: Prospective fault {fault} kA exceeds the largest breaking capacity held ({largest} kA): the breakers need back-up (cascade) protection from a current-limiting device ahead of them, confirmed from the manufacturer’s tables; none is rated here.
note.fault_level_inherited: Fault level {fault} kA taken from {board}, not reduced by the feeder cable; enter this board’s own fault level to rate its breakers lower.
note.discrimination: Each breaker is rated at least {ratio} × the largest breaker after it, so they discriminate on overload. On short circuit, miniature breakers discriminate only up to the upstream breaker’s instantaneous trip (about 5 × In for curve C); where total selectivity is required, confirm it from the manufacturer’s selectivity tables.
note.discrimination_group_raised: Group {group} breaker raised to {rated} A, {ratio} × the {after} A breaker after it, for discrimination.
note.discrimination_group_not_met: Group {group} breaker: {rated} A is less than {ratio} × the {after} A breaker after it, and no larger rating is held for its RCCB; overload discrimination is not assured.
note.discrimination_incomer_raised: Incomer raised to {rated} A, {ratio} × the {after} A breaker after it, for discrimination.
note.discrimination_feeder_raised: Feeder to {board} raised to {rated} A, {ratio} × the {after} A breaker after it on {board}, for discrimination; its cable is sized for {rated} A.
note.discrimination_incomer_not_met: Incomer: {rated} A is less than {ratio} × the {after} A breaker after it, and a larger miniature breaker is not held; overload discrimination is not assured.
note.incomer_isolator: The incomer is a switch-disconnector: {board}’s feeder breaker protects this board, so the switch is rated no lower than that breaker and does not trip; the feeder discriminates with this board’s breakers.
note.isolator_unselected: Incomer: no switch-disconnector rating held carries {current} A (up to 250 A); none is selected here.
note.fault_level_calculated: Fault level {fault} kA, calculated from {board}’s {upstream} kA through {length} m of {section} mm² {material} feeder (IEC 60909, conductors at 20 °C).
note.starting_drop_upsized: {load}: cable enlarged from {sized} to {section} mm² for starting: {multiple} × Ir at cos φ 0.35 drops {total} % from the origin, within the {limit} % allowed while starting.
note.starting_drop_exceeded: {load}: while starting the drop from the origin is {total} %, above the {limit} % allowed, and no tabulated section brings it within; kept at {section} mm². Consider a soft starter or a drive.
note.starting_drop_unchecked: {load}: the drop while starting is not checked for aluminium cable (no start-up column is tabulated).
note.earth_fault_basis: Earth fault disconnection checked from Ze {ze} Ω at U0 {voltage} V: Zs x Ia <= 0.95 U0, Ia the top of the breaker’s instantaneous band (5, 10, 20 In for curves B, C, D), conductors at their maximum operating temperature, protective conductor the size of the line conductors (IEC 60364-4-41 §411.4.4).
note.earth_fault_upsized: {load}: cable enlarged from {sized} to {section} mm² so its breaker disconnects an earth fault at the far end: Zs {loop} Ω, within {limit} Ω (IEC 60364-4-41 §411.4.4).
note.earth_fault_exceeded: {load}: Zs {loop} Ω is above the {limit} Ω at which its {rated} A curve {curve} breaker trips at once, at every cable size held; protect the circuit with a residual current device (IEC 60364-4-41 §411.4.5).
note.earth_fault_tt_no_rcd: {load}: in a TT system only a residual current device disconnects an earth fault in time (IEC 60364-4-41 §411.5); put this circuit under one.
note.earth_fault_no_ze: No Ze is given for this board, so circuits not under a residual current device are not checked for disconnection on an earth fault; enter the measured or declared Ze.
note.earth_fault_unchecked: {count, plural, one {# circuit is not checked for earth fault disconnection: no cable length, a motor starter’s breaker, or a breaker not selected here.} other {# circuits are not checked for earth fault disconnection: no cable length, a motor starter’s breaker, or a breaker not selected here.}}
note.earth_loop_calculated: Ze {ze} Ω, from {board}’s {upstream} Ω plus the loop of {length} m of {section} mm² {material} feeder at its maximum operating temperature.
note.short_circuit_min_upsized: {load}: cable enlarged from {sized} to {section} mm² so a short circuit at its far end trips its breaker at once: Ikmin {current} A, at least {trip} A (ABB handbook §2.4).
note.short_circuit_min_exceeded: {load}: a short circuit at the far end draws only {current} A, below the {trip} A that trips its {rated} A curve {curve} breaker at once, at every cable size held; shorten the run or protect it with a lower curve or rating.
note.short_circuit_withstand: Each cable’s withstand k²S² is in the cable list; compare it with the selected breaker’s let-through I²t at {fault} kA from its maker’s curve (ABB handbook §2.4).
note.demand_factors: Incomer rated for {demand} A on the most loaded conductor after the company’s demand factors; {connected} A is connected. The factors are the company’s, not a standard’s.
